negative_findings.description: Direct navigation inventory of kb.mk (Комерцијална банка) returned no section for набавки, тендери, огласи за прибирање понуди or supplier registration. Only IR, financial reports, news and media contact exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: No supplier/tender page found on the largest MK bank's website.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: for the biggest buyer in the market there is zero direct procurement disclosure, so collection must fall back to financial statements and press.

negative_findings.description: Navigation inventory of stb.com.mk (Стопанска банка) likewise showed no procurement, tender or supplier section; the closest items are 'Податоци и извештаи' and 'Новости'.
negative_findings.result_summary: No tender/RFP page on Stopanska Banka.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Second systemic bank with no direct channel; reinforces that A2 coverage for MK private banks cannot be built on bank-published tenders.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language queries using the exact domestic procurement vocabulary (оглас за прибирање понуди, јавен повик за понудувачи, набавка, тендер) combined with bank names returned only (a) recruitment ads, (b) foreclosed-property sale ads, and (c) generic public-procurement law material — never a bank buying-side call.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language procurement terms are used by MK banks almost exclusively for HIRING and for SELLING repossessed assets, not for buying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a terminology trap: naive keyword collection on 'оглас'/'повик' against bank domains will produce a corpus that is ~all noise. Filters must exclude вработување and продажба на преземен/недвижен имот.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) procurement pages for MK banks were pursued in this pass, although Albanian is widely used by parts of the MK banking customer base (notably Halkbank and TTK).
negative_findings.result_summary: sq coverage not attempted; run scope specified mk+en only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A small residual risk that an sq-language 'thirrje për oferta' notice exists and was missed.

negative_findings.description: Silk Road Banka (Силк Роуд банка АД Скопје) did not surface with any usable procurement or annual-report URL in the local-language sweep; only aggregate mentions appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: No confirmed URL captured for Silk Road Banka in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One named actor in the cell remains uncovered; must be closed in a follow-up pass rather than assumed absent.

coverage_gaps.description: Silk Road Banka and Sparkasse Bank Makedonija have no captured annual-report/IR URL in this slice; ProCredit MK has no confirmed tender page despite sister banks publishing them.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a site-scoped sweep (site:silkroadbank.com.mk, site:sparkasse.mk, site:pcb.mk) for 'оглас', 'повик', 'годишен извештај', 'тендер', plus their MSE/SEI-NET issuer feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: No supplier-registration / vendor-onboarding portals were found for any MK private bank, and no group-level supplier portals were confirmed for Erste/Steiermärkische (Sparkasse), OTP/NBG (Stopanska) or Türkiye Halk Bankası (Halkbank).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate each parent group's global procurement/supplier page and any group e-sourcing platform (SAP Ariba/Coupa tenant), since MK subsidiaries are likely onboarded through them.

coverage_gaps.description: Because banks publish no award notices, vendor identity must be inferred indirectly; no systematic indirect-evidence channel is yet in the source set (e.g. vendor-side press releases and case studies naming MK banks, ATM/POS certification lists, job ads naming a specific core-banking product).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a vendor-side and job-ad workstream: monitor supplier press rooms and MK job boards for product-name mentions tied to each bank.

coverage_gaps.description: e-nabavki.gov.mk institution/notice grids are ASP.NET postback-driven and SEI-NET requires per-issuer navigation; neither is reliably collectable with plain HTTP fetches.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision a headless-browser collector with retry/backoff for these two systems and treat any single failed fetch as unverified, not dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language procurement vocabulary (thirrje për oferta, prokurim, tender) was not searched for MK banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq query set for Halkbank, TTK, Silk Road and NLB MK in a follow-up pass.

brief: North Macedonia's commercial banks are privately owned and therefore sit entirely outside the Law on Public Procurement, and this pass confirms empirically what that implies: neither Komercijalna (kb.mk) nor Stopanska (stb.com.mk) — nor, on search evidence, NLB MK, Halkbank, Sparkasse, ProCredit, UNIBank or TTK — operates any tender, RFP or supplier-registration page, and the local terms оглас / јавен повик / повик за понуди are used by these banks almost exclusively for recruitment and for selling foreclosed assets, which makes naive keyword collection nearly all noise. The only genuinely direct procurement disclosure in the cell comes from the state-owned Development Bank (mbdp.com.mk Јавни набавки and Јавни огласи), with the National Bank's Јавни набавки page and e-nabavki.gov.mk serving as adjacent benchmarks for banking-grade specifications, price levels and incumbent vendors. For the private banks the practical spine is indirect and mandatory-disclosure-driven: SEI-NET and the MSE issuer pages for price-sensitive filings and audited statements, and the banks' own annual reports, where mid-tier banks such as UNIBank do narrate concrete capex items. Group-level channels (NLB Group's javni razpisi, ProCredit's sister-bank tender pages) plus MK trade press are the remaining routes, and the biggest open gaps are parent-group supplier portals and a vendor-side/job-ad channel to substitute for the award notices that will never be published.
